description: Write entries from the database into config/sync with the plugin's own export, in the exact form config-sync compares. Only entries that differ; one only in config/sync has its file deleted; an `invalid-file` is replaced only when named. Commit the files with the code that caused them. It loads the project's Strapi the way config-sync's CLI does, which writes to the database as a `strapi develop` start does (schema sync, migrations): a local development database only — a remote one, or a Strapi 4 database under Strapi 5 code, is refused first.

from.description: A path inside the project (the file you are editing; relative to its root with `project`), in a multi-project workspace.

keys.description: The entries to export (default: every difference).

project.description: A project name or root, when no path is at hand.

name: config_sync_export
title: config-sync: export entries from the database into config/sync
